title: Host adapter binding configuration schema
description: Validation schema for harness/adapters/<env>/tools.yaml: the host-specific tool/payload binding the HookService reads. INTERNAL configuration — harness-owned (ships with the harness, resolved structurally), unlike the conf/*.conf.yaml files which are the embedding framework's EXTERNAL configuration. Both families go through the same one-act loader (parse + contract-validate); only ownership and location differ. host_session_keys/host_parent_session_keys extract host-observed sessionId/parentSessionId values for adapter-mediated sessions; other invocation surfaces may mint or source session ids outside this adapter binding.

additionalProperties.description: The harness action verb this host tool performs.

delete_tools.description: Host tool names that delete files.

items.description: One host tool name that performs deletion.

tool_keys.description: Ordered payload field names to probe for the host tool name.

input_keys.description: Ordered payload field names to probe for the tool's input argument.

path_keys.description: Ordered payload field names to probe for the target artifact path.

actor_keys.description: Ordered payload field names to probe for the acting agent identity.

host_session_keys.description: Ordered payload field names to probe for the host-observed session id.

host_parent_session_keys.description: Ordered payload field names to probe for the host-observed parent session id.

dispatch_tools.description: Host tool names that start a child step-session (subagent dispatch).

items.description: One host tool name that performs subagent dispatch.

dispatch_agent_keys.description: Ordered payload field names to probe for the dispatched agent identity.

dispatch_model_keys.description: Ordered payload field names to probe for the model profile identifier.

keyList.description: Ordered payload field names to probe (first hit wins).
